name: GaussianMesh
definition: A method that defines Gaussians over an explicit mesh and ties the two via joint refinement: GS rendering guides adaptive face and Gaussian splitting, while mesh constraints regularize Gaussian shapes and support large, interactive deformations driven by mesh editing.
summary: GaussianMesh defines 3D Gaussians over an explicit triangle mesh to enable large-scale, interactive deformations without relying on implicit MLP-based skinning.
